name: 1pcs Multicolor Baby Bath Shower Cup/Mug
description:
Material:Plastic 
Suitable age : 1-2 years old, 0-1 years old, newborn, 2-3 years old 
It not only can wash head but also can water the flower like the flower pot. 
Size:21x16x10.7cm 
Package Included: 1 * Shampoo Rinse Cup 
From now on, enjoy bath time with your kid! 
This should be used by the baby to wash the shampoo out of his or her hair. 
The soft rinse cup for baby baths keeps soap and water out of the child's eyes. 
Made of high-quality PP with a matte finish and a long lifespan. 
There is a detachable and simple-to-clean option for the baby and mom.
